intro: B2: social media, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence in everyday life. A topic where it's easy to slip into calques from English — we practise arguing in Polish.
speaking.0.promptUa: Describe the illustration and comment on the situation. Say how excessive phone use affects family relationships, and suggest how this could change.
speaking.0.phrases.0.ua: In the foreground you can see…, while in the background…
speaking.0.phrases.1.ua: One can get the impression that…
speaking.0.phrases.3.ua: It's worth introducing a rule that…
speaking.0.tips.0: **Odnieść wrażenie, że…** — «to get the impression that…»: an elegant way to express a guess at B2.
speaking.0.tips.1: Analyse the cause (przyczyną może być…) rather than just describing the fact — that's B2-level interpretation.
speaking.0.tips.2: A specific proposal («telefony zostają w innym pokoju») is worth more than the general «trzeba mniej korzystać z telefonu».
speaking.1.promptUa: Does artificial intelligence make our lives better, or does it mainly bring threats? State your opinion, give examples and comment on opponents' concerns.
speaking.1.phrases.0.ua: Artificial intelligence brings both benefits and threats.
speaking.1.phrases.1.ua: On the one hand…, on the other hand, however…
speaking.1.phrases.3.ua: The key question is who bears responsibility for…
speaking.1.tips.0: **Trudno o jednoznaczną ocenę** — «it's hard to give a clear-cut assessment»: a good phrase for a balanced thesis.
speaking.1.tips.1: A personal example («korzystam z asystenta głosowego») makes an abstract topic come alive.
speaking.1.tips.2: **Pod warunkiem, że…** saves the day again — it closes a thesis without being categorical.
speaking.2.promptUa: You received an e-mail that looks like a phishing attempt and concerns your bank account. You call the bank's helpline to check. Describe the situation and ask about the next steps.
speaking.2.phrases.0.ua: I received a suspicious e-mail about my account.
speaking.2.phrases.2.ua: I didn't click on any link.
speaking.2.tips.0: **Skoro** («since/given that») — a subordinating conjunction, good for B2: «konto jest bezpieczne, skoro nic Pani nie podała».
speaking.2.tips.1: Clarify right away whether you clicked a link — that's the key detail in any phishing situation.
speaking.2.tips.2: Finish by asking about prevention («dodatkowe powiadomienia») — it shows you're proactive.
writing.0.promptUa: Since this morning the customer-service system at your company hasn't worked. Write an e-mail to the IT department: describe the problem, say who is affected, and ask when the system will work again.
writing.0.phrases.0.ua: I'm writing about an urgent matter — a system failure.
writing.0.phrases.1.ua: The problem affects the whole customer-service team.
writing.0.phrases.2.ua: Please let me know when the system will work again.
writing.0.tips.0: **W międzyczasie** — «in the meantime»: a useful word when asking for advice while you wait.
writing.0.tips.1: Convey urgency without a panicked tone: «w pilnej sprawie» + a polite request.
writing.1.promptUa: Write a blog article on the topic: «Social media — does it connect people or rather divide them?». Give arguments for and against, refer to your own experience and suggest how to use it consciously.
writing.1.phrases.0.ua: It's hard to imagine today's world without social media.
writing.1.phrases.1.ua: On the one hand, it lets you stay in touch with…
writing.1.phrases.2.ua: On the other hand, it encourages comparing yourself with others.
writing.1.phrases.3.ua: That's why it's worth consciously limiting the time spent online.
writing.1.tips.0: **I jedno, i drugie, w zależności od…** — an elegant answer to an «either-or» dilemma, typical of a B2 essay.
writing.1.tips.1: **Paradoksalnie** — «paradoxically»: a word that instantly shows a higher stylistic level.
writing.1.tips.2: Three concrete rules at the end are worth more than the general advice «spend less time on your phone».
listening.0.intro: A radio interview with a psychologist about children's safety online.
grammar.0.intro: Complex sentences, participles and conjunctions in the topic of technology and security.
grammar.0.questions.2.why: **doznać awarii** — to suffer a failure; perfective past tense.
